payload.title: P27 — Publish authoring recipes and portable showcase
payload.description:
## Dispatch packet P27
Read initiative videoml-dbc2b1 sections D03,D05,D06 before editing. Those are binding decisions, not suggestions.

## Repositories and edit scope
videoml-org, stdlib
Primary paths: docs and showcase fixtures. Read repository AGENTS before any edits. Do not edit unrelated product code.

## Procedure
1. Read prerequisites and existing implementation at the paths above.
2. Add failing behavioral fixtures for the listed acceptance cases.
3. Publish visual-only and Auritus-narrated examples for pacing/easing/stagger/holds/cuts with source and expected artifacts. Use already verified catalog entries; document export/local rendering and optional Babulus service.
4. Run scoped checks plus required repo quality gates. Save actual commands, exit status and artifacts in an issue comment.
5. Return the diff and evidence to the primary reviewer; do not close the issue yourself.

## Acceptance
browser review and copied examples rendered from clean consumer.

## Dependencies
videoml-a2767d (P12), videoml-42506c (P16), videoml-f708b4 (P17)

## Stop conditions
Do not guess a missing credential/account identity, bypass a failed test, substitute mocked evidence for a real smoke run, expand product scope, or change contract defaults. Report a precise blocker and return to the primary reviewer. A passing build alone is insufficient for rendering behavior.
